description: Every arm of an exhaustive block `<match>` mounts the declaration inside its own render: E-DECL-RENDER-CYCLE-USE (#2139 review MED-2; before r1 the bootstrap compile hung).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-component-self-mount-error ("a use of a declaration inside its own render ... that is unconditional on every path is a compile error at the use"); PA reading pa-ruled:S483-every-path-mounts (an exhaustive `<match>` every arm of which mounts it: every path mounts it)
rationale: §66.6.2 rule 2 (S483 r1): each arm of a block `<match>` whose arms cover every variant mounts it.
